name: @yottameta/yotta-learn
description: Yuanxi — a cross-agent learning-loop skill with a file-based knowledge base: captures mistakes, corrections and insights as reusable .learnings/ entries, and keeps verified knowledge in categorized, indexed, keyword-searchable KB entries that any agent can read and write via CLI. Triggers on command failure / user correction / a better approach / a missing capability / an external-interface failure / stale knowledge / a need to capture or query experience. Boundaries: never records private/sensitive info unless explicitly requested; never auto-modifies system files.
